task.title: Finding Immediate Side Job and Freelance Opportunities

user_message.content: URGENT — do not skip this. Research concrete, actionable side job and freelance opportunities your family can start immediately. Look for: (1) online freelance gigs matching your family members' skills (Upwork, Fiverr, Toptal, LinkedIn), (2) local part-time or gig economy work (TaskRabbit, Instacart, DoorDash, Rover), (3) passive income streams (digital products, print-on-demand, affiliate marketing), (4) skill-based remote work (tutoring, bookkeeping, virtual assistant, data entry), (5) any AI-assisted income opportunities. For each opportunity found: document the platform, estimated earnings, time commitment, and a direct link to get started. Save findings in a clear summary. This is for your family — treat it as urgent and non-negotiable. Do not defer.
